title: Command: supersede
lead:
`dlog supersede OLD --by NEW` links two decided records and marks OLD as
`superseded`.
boundary: **Not in this slice:** lint for supersede cycles.

sections.heading: Why
sections.body: Goal 4: supersede a decision while keeping its history.

sections.heading: Files
sections.body: The `commands` and `model` modules and CLI tests.

sections.heading: Failing tests
sections.body:
- After `supersede A --by B`, A is `superseded`, A.superseded_by = B and
  B.supersedes = A; both get history lines.
- `context` no longer includes A; `show A` still shows A and its history
  (acceptance criterion).
- Superseding a record that is not `decided`, or with a NEW that is not
  `decided`, fails.

sections.heading: Implement
sections.body: Use the model's decided -> superseded transition and write both records.

sections.heading: Check
sections.body:
- The project test command passes.
- `slicer check --json` is clean.
